I try to make my lessons fun and engaging and adapt my teaching to suit the needs of my audience. My lessons are 30 - 90 mins in duration and are focussed towards teaching conversational English, Business English and I also assist in helping with SPaG - which stands for spelling, punctuation and grammar. I make my lessons very interactive and give lots of hints and tips along the way when a student is trying to improve any aspect of the language. When we try to look for online articles to talk about, I let the student take the lead in deciding exactly what to talk about in order to develop the ideas and concepts and also to broaden their vocabulary in an area that may interest them. I do however have an extensive list of interesting topics. 
Just take a little look at my prices!

pro_course_detail.title: Pronunciation Improvement for ESL Speakers!
pro_course_detail.description:
- Course Description:
Individualized  pronunciation practice and drills for English as a Second Language (ESL) speakers.

- Course Objectives:

at the conclusion of this course, students should be able to:
1. Recite English words demonstrating front, central, and back pronunciation of vowels.
2. Recite English words using consonant sounds, including stops, fricatives, affricates, nasals, liquid sounds, and glides.
3. Identify correct sounds and words from minimal pairs and consonant clusters.
4. Recite grammatical endings, including "s," "es," and "ed."
5. Speak and read aloud words based on standard English stress patterns.
6. Speak and read aloud phrases and sentences using standard English intonation (stress) patterns.
7. Identify statemens and questions based on standard English intonation patterns.

teacher_info.intro: Friendly attitude, native Lithuanian, 10 years of teaching experience, certified C2 English knowledge, corporate experience, huge interest in languages, Я также говорю на русском!
teacher_info.introduction:
Hi, My name is Šarūnas, I am a native Lithuanian speaker and a certified language teacher from Lithuania. I have taught Lithuanian and English for five years; I have worked as a classroom teacher as well as a tutor for individual students both in-person and online. On top of that I have lived in the US for a year and also have had various jobs at large international companies (Western Union to name but a few) which means I have used the languages I know on a more experienced level than an average speaker. I love what I do now and my lessons are fun for me and it is the same for my students too, it seems. I don't believe that learning a foreign language goes the same way as learning other subjects (i.e. maths or history). Learning a foreign language means learning a new skill. It has a lot to do with knowledge of words and grammar but equally important is how you feel using it. I have known many people who had learnt a language at school but where too worried and self-cautious to use it in public. I do my best to help if that is the case. Trust me, learning Lithuanian or English can be really fun. Just order a trial with me and you'll see it yourself! 

If you wish to study at evening time, please send me a message and we'll arrange that.

Best wishes, Šarūnas
